title: A bound on a logarithmic exponent
statement: For all nonnegative integers $n$ and $H$, let $r$ be the least nonnegative integer such that $n+1\le 2^r$. Then $2^{H(\lfloor\sqrt r\rfloor+1)}\le 2^{2H}(n+1)^H$.
